_how_to_edit: Edit this file on GitHub; Pug picks it up within an hour. notes: each one is said once, from show_from on (yyyy-MM-dd); give every note a new id; a blank line (\n\n) splits a note into speech bubbles. letters: one per monthly anniversary, keyed by the month count; each needs title, pages, button, signature and after (the lines he says when she opens the gift). since: the day you got together.
